attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited filed the transcript of the earnings conference call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call was held on November 12, 2026. The company reported its Q2FY27 financial results. Management discussed the global fire protection equipment market growth. The Indian market is expected to reach INR175 billion to INR195 billion by fiscal 2031. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Jalgaon and Thane. These facilities cover approximately 8.5 acres. The company supplies products to over 90 countries. Key projects include installations at Sriharikota and Jamnagar Refinery. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited received a purchase order dated November 16, 2026, on November 17, 2026, for the supply of fire protection equipment and accessories. The order was awarded by a domestic entity, whose identity remains undisclosed due to confidentiality obligations. The total consideration is approximately Rs.6 crores plus applicable taxes. Delivery is scheduled within 10 to 12 weeks from manufacturing clearance, with execution occurring in one or more tranches. Payment will be processed through RXIL or M1 Exchange. A standard one-year warranty applies to the supplied products. The company confirms that the promoter group has no interest in the customer and the transaction does not constitute a related party transaction. This information is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations and is available on the company website.

attchmntText: HD Fire Protect Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: HD Fire Protect Limited published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in the Financial Express and Loksatta newspapers on November 14, 2026. The standalone Net Profit after tax for the three months ended September 30, 2026, was 2888.78 lakhs, compared to 2048.15 lakhs in the same period last year. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the Net Profit after tax was 5202.80 lakhs, versus 4714.67 lakhs in the previous year. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. The intimation is available on the company website at www.hdfire.com.
